findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “If preachers, sermon after sermon…”
findings.source_quote: It entrenches complacent legalism into the core of the heart of man.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Hukita uhalali wa kisheria uliotulia ndani kabisa ya moyo wa mwanadamu.” with “Hukita uhalali wa kisheria” with a Kiswahili expression meaning complacent legalism—for example, “Hukita ndani kabisa ya moyo wa mwanadamu ushikiliaji wa sheria usiojali.”
